files.description:
Train station in Cambridge, UK - rainy afternoon. Short recording of me standing inside one of the station's shelters, a bit of water dripping from the makeshift ceiling. The other 2 samples of this pack were recorded outside.
Recorded April 2005 with a Sony Minidisc and a small Sony condenser micro
files.author: andre.nascimento

files.description:
